title: Moana Floating Tiki Bar on the Ottawa River (Ottawa PickUp)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Climb aboard our Hawaiian-style Tiki Hut and enjoy a relaxing cruise along the beautiful Ottawa River with your family, friends, or coworkers! Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion, enjoying a romantic escape, or bringing a school group for a unique heritage experience, there’s no better way to experience Canada’s capital from the water.

Simply head to one of our departure locations, step aboard, and become part of the Ottawa Ohana!

Prefer to depart from the Quebec side? Simply send us a message after booking or choose one of our Quebec departure tours.
